About

Hey! I’m Andrii — a 2D/3D animator and motion designer, currently studying at Willem de Kooning Academie in Rotterdam. I’ve been a nerd about everything animation-related since I was a kid, and I’m always up for interesting projects.

  • Based Rotterdam, NL
  • Currently WDKA — HBO
  • Tools Clip Studio · Moho · Blender · Toon Boom · Illustrator · Unity · After Effects · TVPaint
  • Available Freelance · Internship · Part-time

Built solo in Unity — design, art and animation. It came out of my own insomnia: the world and its creatures are shaped by the sleep paralysis demon that shows up on the nights I can’t sleep.
